entries.title: Psalms 60:1
segments:
Title, Aram-naharaim; Syria of the two rivers; that is, Mesopotamia. 
 
  Aram-zobah; that is, Syria Zobah.  This country probably lay northeast of Damascus, on the west side of the Euphrates. 
 
  Returned; from the expedition against Syria. 
 
  Of Edom in the valley of salt; probably the valley at the south end of the Dead sea, which is at the present day bordered on the west by a salt mountain.  For the events referred to in this title, see notes on

. 
 

 
  Thou hast cast us off; the first three verses of the psalm refer to the period before the victories celebrated in the remaining verses. 
 
Trials are the consequences of sin, and should lead us to self-examination, repentance, and hearty turning unto the Lord.

entries.title: Psalms 60:3
segments:
Thou hast showed thy people hard things; afflictions, especially reverses in war. 
 
  Drink the wine of astonishment; wine that produces giddiness and reeling; a frequent scriptural metaphor to express the amazement and perplexity produced by God's heavy judgments.
Even the people of God, if they sin against him, are often visited with great and sore troubles, from which nothing but his grace can deliver them.

entries.title: Psalms 60:4
segments: A banner; as a signal and pledge of God's presence.  The allusion is to a military standard elevated on the top of a mountain as a rallying point in time of war.  Here God himself furnishes the banner, and thus pledges his presence and help.

entries.title: Psalms 60:6
segments: Shechem--Succoth; two places of the land of Israel, the former on the west side of Jordan, the latter on the east.  They stand here as representatives of all the cities of Israel.

entries.title: Psalms 60:7
segments:
Gilead--Manasseh--Ephraim; three regions put to represent the whole land which should be subjected to David's power. 
 
  The strength of my head; my helmet, that is, my defence. 
 
  My lawgiver; the seat of my kingdom.
Jehovah is king over all, and the rightful proprietor of all the kingdoms and nations of the earth.

entries.title: Psalms 60:8
segments:
My washpot; put to dishonorable service as a conquered people. 
 
  Cast out my shoe; probably in token of possession.

entries.title: Psalms 60:9
segments: The strong city; Petra, the capital of Edom.

entries.title: Psalms 60:11
segments: God is the only effectual helper in trouble, and to him alone men should look as their deliverer.

entries.title: Psalms 60:12
segments: Tread down our enemies; enable us to overcome them.
